claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D3400 DSLR Camera With 70-300mm Lens.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black Nikon DSLR with a large zoom lens and a DX label on the lens barrel, but the exact camera model number (D3400) and the exact lens model/part number (70-300mm) are not fully readable in the provided angles.

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of functionality (no shutter test, autofocus test, sensor check, or display/EVF/controls verification).

risks.risk: Camera model mismatch (could be another Nikon DX DSLR), which changes value and compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the camera model text on the body (e.g., 'D3400') plus the lens model/part number ring/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Nikon DSLR with an unspecified zoom lens (worst-case for model certainty).

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 70-300mm (could be different focal length/model), affecting resale value.
risks.proof: A sharp photo of the lens model/part number and focal length markings (front ring and/or barrel label).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unspecified used Nikon zoom lens (worst-case for lens spec).

risks.risk: Hidden functional faults (shutter issues, autofocus problems, dead pixels, sensor dust/fungus, or lens haze).
risks.proof: Video/clip showing: power on, live view/EVF working, autofocus locking on a target, and a short shutter test (multiple shots) plus a photo of a blank white wall at high ISO to reveal sensor dust.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'not fully tested / may need service' (worst-case for working condition).

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear beyond what’s visible (scratches on screen/eyepiece, dents, or deeper scuffs).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the LCD screen, viewfinder/eyepiece, hot shoe area, and lens front element under light.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for visible scuffing/wear.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, lens hood, straps, manuals) can materially reduce value.
risks.proof: A full photo inventory laid out: battery, charger, USB/AV cables (if any), memory card, lens hood, caps, strap, and any box/receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming key accessories may be missing.

risks.risk: Battery health/charge holding capacity unknown; could be weak or failing.
risks.proof: A clip showing battery level during operation and a test run (e.g., powering on and taking several shots).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera body model marking (confirm D3400) and serial/label area.
Clear close-up photo of the lens model/part number and focal length marking (confirm 70-300mm).
Video clip: power on + LCD/EVF view, autofocus lock test on a nearby and far subject, and a short shutter test (multiple shots).
Photo of a blank white wall/sky at high ISO to check for sensor dust/dead pixels.
Close-up photos of LCD screen, viewfinder/eyepiece, lens front element, and any visible scratches/dents.
Full accessories inventory photo (battery, charger, memory card, caps/hood, strap, manuals/box if any).
Show battery level during operation (or a short run clip) to indicate battery health.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a Nikon DSLR with a zoom lens, but the exact D3400 body and 70-300mm lens specs—and the 'working perfectly' claim—are not verifiable from the provided images. To price safely in Abuja, we need proof of model/lens identity and basic functionality.
